clauses.description: The agent must not redact a whistleblower report that matches a defined breach-of-Union-law category when no lawful basis for the redaction is present. The adapter classifies the report content against the breach taxonomy and emits ``breach_category_match: true`` when a category is matched; ``lawful_basis_present`` carries the redaction's lawful-basis flag. Both conditions are required because DSL v0.1 supports only equality matching, so the threshold classification is pre-computed by the adapter (Whistleblower Directive 2019/1937 Art. 8-9). Suppression by non-forwarding is addressed by SI-ENTONCES-FORWARD-001.
